analysis.reasonEn: Shifted to buy from 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI confirmed exit from oversold at 48.3→56.9 and settled in neutral zone. MACD histogram improved from -76.2023→539.1344, forming a golden cross. Higher Low pattern continues, with 5-day low 106,235 > 20-day low 101,485 * 1.005.

MACD 히스토그램 -76.2023→539.1344 개선, 골든크로스 형성으로 상승 모멘텀 확인.

MACD histogram improved from -76.2023→539.1344, forming a golden cross and confirming upward momentum.
